name: Pancreatic islet β-cell
failures: Autoimmune destruction in type 1, exhaustion in type 2. Silent until most mass is already gone.

see.note: THE binding gap: there is no clinical way to measure β-cell mass in a living person.

model.note: Glucose control gives a clear functional target.

reach.note: Pancreas is deep, diffuse and enzymatically hostile; islets are a tiny fraction of tissue.

edit.note: Stem-cell-derived islets produced insulin independence in early trials, but require immunosuppression.

verify.note: C-peptide and continuous glucose monitoring are good functional readouts.

anchors: Autoimmunity persists as the chronic driver
